subject: Can't log in with Okta after renaming our domain
body: After we changed our email domain, users get 'user not found' when signing in through Okta SSO.
resolution: The SSO configuration matches users by email. Admin updated the allowed email domain in Settings > Security > SSO and enabled 'match by NameID'. Users could log in immediately.

subject: Export stuck at 'preparing' for 6 hours
body: Our raw event export of ~40 GB has been 'preparing' since this morning.
resolution: Exports over 10 GB must be delivered to an S3 bucket. Customer had no bucket configured, so the job was waiting. Configured S3 destination in Settings > Data > Export; export finished in 35 minutes.

subject: Charged twice for September?
body: We see two invoices for September with slightly different amounts.
resolution: Affected by INC-2291. The first invoice was voided and replaced. Confirmed reissued invoice INV-77120 and applied a one-month 10% credit per the incident macro.

subject: Events arriving late in EU workspace
body: Events from our checkout flow are showing up 15 minutes late in real-time dashboards.
resolution: Known issue DI-4410 under investigation by Data Infra. Customer informed that no data is lost. CSM notified due to Enterprise SLA.

subject: How to move workspace from us-east to eu-central?
body: We need EU data residency for a new contract.
resolution: Region can't be changed in settings after creation. Filed a migration request with Data Infra (takes about 5 business days, requires a 1-hour ingestion pause). Migration is free for Enterprise; for Growth it was approved as a one-time exception by the Support lead.
